_meta.policy: Government/regulator/statute sources support law and tax. Provider-origin pages support only that provider's product or tariff. Operative excerpts were reviewed on 2026-11-09; retrieval does not prove account eligibility or continuous link uptime.

sources.title: Regulation on Foreign Exchange Administration, State Council Order No. 532 (2008)
sources.supports: Current/capital account distinction; liquidation remittance; penalties; definitions.

sources.title: Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange, PBOC Order [2006] No. 3
sources.supports: Domestic vs overseas individual; documented current-income purchase; property sale; emigrant/inheritance carve-out; anti-splitting.

sources.title: Current Account Foreign Exchange Business Guidelines (2020), Huifa [2020] No. 14
sources.supports: USD50k facilitation quota; documented above-quota current-account use; overseas-person income purchase; 24-month reconversion; remittance thresholds; trade and cash rules.

sources.title: Interim Measures for Individual Property Transfer Abroad, PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16
sources.supports: Emigrant and inheritance transfer definitions; tax/property evidence; direct remittance to applicant's own overseas account. Staged-release text superseded by S05.

sources.title: Huifa [2014] No. 2, amended text
sources.supports: Removes staged emigrant remittance and CNY500k central filing; permits one or multiple remittances within approval; combined inheritance applications; removes specified notarization requirements.

sources.title: Capital Account Foreign Exchange Business Guidelines (2024), Huifa [2024] No. 12
sources.supports: Existence and numbering of current capital-account operational sections. Extraction stopped before section 6.4; local service guides S07/S08 supply the detailed checklist.

sources.title: Emigrant property transfer purchase/remittance approval service guide (2024)
sources.supports: Eligibility, identity/residence/hukou cancellation, source/property/tax documents, agency agreement, SAFE approval, no administrative fee, 20-working-day statutory decision period.

sources.title: Inheritance property transfer purchase/remittance approval service guide (2024)
sources.supports: Inheritance evidence, decedent property rights, tax certificate, identity documents, SAFE approval. Contains an internal eligibility-copy irregularity flagged for review.

sources.title: SAFE FAQ: What is individual property transfer abroad? (2026)
sources.supports: Current reaffirmation of emigrant pre-status lawful property and inheritance definitions.

sources.title: SAFE FAQ: Where to apply for property transfer (2026)
sources.supports: Original household-registration SAFE office for emigrants; decedent's former household-registration office for inheritance.

sources.title: SAFE FAQ: No foreign-currency cash withdrawal after approved property transfer (2026)
sources.supports: Approved funds must be remitted directly to applicant's own account in country/region of residence.

sources.title: SAFE FAQ: Insurance proceeds for overseas beneficiary (2022)
sources.supports: Lawfully purchased insurance proceeds may be purchased/remitted as lawful RMB income with policy and insurer payment proof.

sources.title: Bank of China service tariff landing (effective 2025-11-11)
sources.locator: Personal finance PDF link and notices
sources.supports: Current tariff index and future ATM notice.

sources.title: Bank of China personal finance tariff, Chapter 3 (effective 2025-11-11)
sources.supports: TT/draft commission CNY50-260 at 0.1%; international cable CNY150; draft postage actual; USD full-arrival USD15/25; overseas charges actual; ATM CNY12+1% max112; foreign-currency carry permit fee waived through 2026-12-31.

sources.title: Bank of China ATM fee change notice effective 2026-11-11
sources.supports: Future UnionPay unchanged; Mastercard/Visa 2.5% min USD3 max USD40 from 2026-11-11. Not applied on research date.

sources.title: Bank of China indicative FX board
sources.supports: Observed bid 666.48 / ask 669.29 / reference 671.68 per USD100, provider timestamp 2026-11-09 07:14:36. Indicative only; actual transaction rate governs. Round-trip bid/ask spread about 0.42% is not a one-way conversion loss.

sources.title: HSBC China mandatory information / current tariff index
sources.supports: Current English and Chinese tariff documents.

sources.title: HSBC China tariff of accounts and services (Chinese, effective 2026-10-31)
sources.supports: Private banking individual TT commission/cable free; Premier/Advance 0.1% min100 max500 + cable120; Global Transfer actual USD20; education payment actual USD7; ATM tariffs; exclusions.

sources.title: HSBC China tariff of accounts and services (English, effective 2026-10-31)
sources.supports: English confirmation of Global Transfer to self/family and education-payment fees and country limits.

sources.title: Wise guide to CNY transfers
sources.supports: Eligible non-mainland-Chinese individuals with China work/tax records; own overseas account only; bank app CNY300k / Alipay CNY50k per transfer; net-income overall limit.

sources.supports: Observed bank-funded fee CNY436.18; Wise-balance fee CNY419.89. Not a locked quote.

sources.supports: Observed bank-funded fee CNY848.58; Wise-balance fee CNY832.29. Not a locked quote.

sources.supports: Observed bank-funded fee CNY1574.68 after CNY99.31 discount; Wise-balance CNY1558.39. Not a locked quote.

sources.title: Western Union China outbound send-money page
sources.locator: Top notice; online/in-person steps; partner banks; ID rules
sources.supports: Bank-account payout temporarily unavailable; cash pickup via partner banks; passport excludes HK/Macau/TW; local compliance restrictions; no numeric fee schedule.

sources.title: MoneyGram China how to send money
sources.supports: Generic agent-location steps only; does not verify CNY-to-USD own-account corridor, limits, or fees.

sources.title: PayPal C2 help: How do I send money?
sources.supports: International payments to non-mainland PayPal accounts; does not establish CNY bank-funded own-account repatriation.

sources.title: SAFE card overseas cash withdrawal notice explainer, Huifa [2017] No. 29
sources.supports: CNY100k/person/year and CNY10k/card/day overseas ATM caps; borrowed cards prohibited; normal consumption unaffected.

sources.title: SAFE operating rules for carrying foreign-currency cash in/out of China
sources.locator: Carrying foreign currency cash outbound tables
sources.supports: USD5k permit-free; USD5k-10k bank permit; above USD10k generally prohibited except special cases with SAFE permit; frequent-traveler lower caps.

sources.title: CBP currency reporting reminder
sources.supports: More than USD10k currency/monetary instruments entering/leaving US must be declared on FinCEN Form 105.

sources.title: PRC Individual Income Tax Law (2018 amendment)
sources.supports: Residence rules; nine income categories; 20% proportional categories; property gain net basis; foreign tax credit; emigration tax clearance.

sources.title: STA housing transfer IIT notice, Guoshuifa [2006] No. 108
sources.supports: Actual price; documented deductions; 1%-3% assessed alternative; five-year sole-home exemption.

sources.title: Foreign individual dividend IIT policy announcement, MOF/STA 2026 No. 27
sources.supports: 20% IIT on FIE dividends to foreign individuals from 2026-09-01; repeals 1994 exemption.

sources.title: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Implementation Regulations
sources.supports: 10% reduced EIT rate for specified nonresident-enterprise income; withholding mechanics.

sources.title: Outbound service-trade tax filing supplementary announcement / FAQ
sources.locator: Full FAQ citing 2021 No. 19 and 2013 No. 40
sources.supports: Tax filing before first outbound payment exceeding USD50k under same contract; not a tax itself.

sources.title: U.S.-China income tax treaty (1984)
sources.supports: 10% dividend/interest source-state caps subject to beneficial ownership and residence; U.S. credit; saving clause.

sources.title: IRS Foreign Tax Credit
sources.supports: Credit is limited; treaty-reduced tax only; no credit for FEIE-excluded income.

sources.title: IRS Publication 525 (2025), Foreign currency transactions
sources.supports: Personal FX gain over USD200 reported as capital gain.

sources.title: 26 U.S.C. §988 (2024 U.S. Code)
sources.supports: Ordinary FX gain/loss default; personal-transaction exception; USD200 threshold disapplies exclusion for the transaction, not just excess.

sources.title: IRS Form 8938 vs FBAR comparison
sources.supports: Separate FBAR/FATCA duties and thresholds.

sources.title: 31 CFR 1010.821 penalty adjustment table
sources.supports: Adjusted maxima USD16,536 nonwillful / USD165,353 willful for assessments on/after 2025-01-17. eCFR is continuously updated but not the official legal edition; statutory ceiling remains USD100k or 50% for willful cases.

sources.title: Bittner v. United States, No. 21-1195 (2023)
sources.supports: Nonwillful FBAR penalty accrues per report, not per account.

sources.title: IRS Gifts from foreign person
sources.supports: Form 3520 threshold >USD100k from nonresident alien/foreign estate; 2026 foreign-entity purported-gift threshold USD20,573; covered-expatriate exception.

sources.title: IRS remittance transfer tax proposed regulations release, IR-2026-48
sources.supports: 1% tax from 2026-01-01 on specified physical-instrument-funded remittances sent from the United States, not China-to-US transfers.

sources.title: PBOC etc. virtual-currency and RWA risk notice, Yinfa [2026] No. 42
sources.supports: Current prohibition of virtual-currency exchange business in mainland China; 2021 No. 237 expressly repealed.

sources.title: PBOC/NFRA/CSRC Order [2025] No. 11, customer due diligence rules
sources.supports: From 2026-01-01, outbound remittance identity verification at CNY5000/USD1000; information transmission; not a new FX quota.

sources.title: SAFE employee stock incentive plan notice, Huifa [2012] No. 7
sources.supports: Registered plan, domestic agent, offshore trustee, quota, dedicated account, repatriation mechanics. Not a general savings-export route.

sources.title: SAFE direct investment simplification notice, Huifa [2015] No. 13 (amended)
sources.supports: Bank-handled direct-investment registration; some original operational sections repealed. Use 2024 guidelines for current operations.

sources.title: Guangdong government release on Wealth Management Connect 2.0
sources.supports: Southbound individual quota CNY3m; eligibility changes. Official provincial report, not the full joint implementation rules.

sources.title: ICBC Asia Wealth Management Connect product page
sources.supports: RMB closed-loop remittance and repatriation via same route; not free USD repatriation.

sources.locator: Table: JPY 2026-10-28 to 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-20; SGD 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-06; redemption and switching remain available

sources.supports: USD5,000 no-permit tier; USD5,000–10,000 bank permit; above USD10,000 only special cases with SAFE permit.
